A Nexus for Next-Generation BME
SBME is a trailblazer in redefining BME education and research — empowering the next generation to transform healthcare by linking engineering, life sciences, and clinical translation.
The School of Biomedical Engineering (SBME) was founded in March 2025 and represents a unique collaboration between the Faculties of Medicine, Engineering, Dentistry and Sciences at the University of Hong Kong.
EXPLORE MORE
Design Principles for π-conjugated Hydrogel Semiconductors
Professor Shiming Zhang
​
The semiconducting behaviour in hydrogels enables advanced electronic applications for biosystems. This Review provides key principles of the design, fabrication, characterizations and benchmarking for π-conjugated Hydrogel Semiconductors.

Degree Programme
Our Biomedical Engineering (BEng (BME)) programme is training a new generation of biomedical engineers to transform healthcare by combining a deep understanding of human biology with innovative engineering solutions. We empower students to apply fundamental principles and quantitative analysis to address urgent biomedical problems across the lifespan, to enhance health and quality of life and promote healthy aging.
